children: Home Depot has named Richard McPhail as the home-improvement retailer's permanent chief executive, removing the interim tag he has carried since Ted Decker went on a medical leave in August.
Home Depot on Tuesday said Decker, who has returned from the leave, is stepping down as president and CEO of the Atlanta company but will continue as board chair.
Ann-Marie Campbell, the senior executive vice president of U.S. stores and operations, will become president and chief operating officer, the company said.
McPhail joined Home Depot in 2005 and has been executive vice president and chief financial officer since September 2019.
Home Depot said Jordan Broggi, most recently executive vice president of interconnected retail, will succeed McPhail as finance chief.
